method: Read-only pixel analysis. Original/runtime image files were not edited. Unprinted areas selected after visually inspecting runtime texture.
contrast_definition: Each texture-albedo RGB difference from selected paper base, before existing vertex lighting and tone mapping. Not a perceptual/screen-space contrast measurement.
limitation: Flattened texture has no separate ink mask: fine paper-grain and tonal variation also soften 50% about this yellow base.
